user.description:
Name this monitoring entry and select the entities whose states the integration will check for danger messages.

You can create these entities with the [Scrape integration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/scrape) for Telegram channels such as:

- [Air Force of the Armed Forces of Ukraine](https://telegram.me/s/kpszsu)
- [War Monitor](https://telegram.me/war_monitor)

**‼️ Important:** This integration can make mistakes, miss messages, or detect them late.
Do not use it as your only or official alert source. Always follow official alerts and their instructions. During an air-raid alert, immediately go to the nearest shelter and remain there until the official all-clear.
The integration is provided “as is.” The author does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of its data and is not responsible for users’ safety, decisions made, or consequences arising from use of the integration.

data_description.name: Name used for the Aerial Danger monitoring entry and device.
data_description.sources: Select one or more entities whose state contains messages for danger monitoring.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description:
Select regions.

Regions are used to detect ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and other fast threats that may approach your location.

Use either option or combine both.

data_description.region_presets: Optional. Select one or more preset regions.
data_description.region_patterns:
Optional. Add a YAML list where each item is one [regular expression](https://docs.python.org/3/library/re.html) in single quotes.

Example YAML list:

```yaml
- '\bки(їв|єва|єві|єву|євом)\b'
- '\bстолиц(я|і|ю|ею)\b'
```

neighborhoods.title: Neighborhoods
neighborhoods.description:
Select neighborhoods within the chosen regions. Neighborhoods are used to detect drones and all other threat types. You can select multiple neighborhoods.

Use either option or combine both.

data_description.neighborhood_presets:
Optional. Select one or more preset neighborhoods.

**Tip:** Select your neighborhood and nearby neighborhoods to receive notifications about approaching targets.
data_description.neighborhood_patterns:
Optional. Add a YAML list where each item is one [regular expression](https://docs.python.org/3/library/re.html) in single quotes.

Example YAML list:

```yaml
- '\bнив(ки|ках|ками|ок)\b'
- '\bвиноградар(а|і|ем)?\b'
```

error.invalid_pattern_format: Regex patterns must be a YAML list of strings.
error.invalid_pattern: One or more regex patterns are invalid.
error.patterns_required: Enter at least one region or neighborhood pattern.
error.sources_required: Select at least one source entity.
